gate_questions: Is the old opportunity physically completable after opening another?
Does the second opportunity remain unknown before commitment?
Can the old opportunity be reopened later at equal cost?
Does holding both consume capacity or incur an actual risk?
Can the chosen result still be completed after new information?
Does waiting safely dominate early commitment?
Are distinct target completion outcomes shown separately?
Does a short fixed or conditional script already explain the optimal behavior?
Is independent human feedback actually available?
